name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Reduction.steered_le_card_mul_guess
title: An adaptively chosen answer pattern wins at most |P| times as often as a uniformly guessed one
statement: For a finite set of coins Omega with nonnegative weights p, a finite nonempty set P of answer patterns, nonnegative winning values win(omega, g) and any choice function m : Omega -> P, the sum over omega of p(omega) * win(omega, m(omega)) is at most |P| times the sum over omega of p(omega) times the average over g in P of win(omega, g). Used to bound a cheating prover who chooses the answers to the uncertified oracle queries of a black-box witness-encryption security reduction: it wins at most |P| times as often as the efficient run that guesses those answers.
